title: Minicircle Production Protocol for Gene Therapy Without Cleanup Steps
author: Do, Verma, et al.
materials: Agarose, low melting point/molecular biology grade

This section describes transfection, RNA extraction, reverse transcription and quantitative PCR to test the transcript production of minicircle TBX4 in a murine cell line.Note: Any method to introduce plasmids into cells should work. We prefer the TransIT-X2 system, but this should work with calcium phosphate or electroporation. However, other transfection protocols were not tested so efficiency may vary.23.Thaw NIH/3T3 cells in hands by gripping them for 2 min. After, the following steps will be in the hood aside from the centrifugation steps.a.Resuspend the cells in a 50 mL conical with 10 mL of DMEM 10% FBS 1% Antianti warmed to 37°C.b.Pellet the cells at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C and remove the media.c.Resuspend the cells in 10 mL of DMEM 10% FBS 1% Antianti and pellet again at the same speed.d.Remove media while leaving the pellet undisturbed and resuspend in 10 mL of fresh media.e.Plate onto a 10 cm plate and leave in the incubator set at 37°C and 5% CO2.f.When the cells reach around ∼80–90% confluence. Proceed to split.g.Aspirate all media in the dish and add 5 mL of TrypLE.h.Incubate at 37°C for 5 min.i.Wash the plate with 5 mL of DMEM 10% FBS 1% Antianti and collect contents into a 50 mL conical.j.Pellet the cells at 700 g for 5 min at 4°C.k.Remove the media and resuspend in 5 mL of DMEM 10% FBS 1% Antianti.l.To a new 10 cm plate, add 9 mL of DMEM 10% FBS 1% Antianti and add 1 mL of the cell suspension to the plate.m.Repeat twice to ensure healthy growth before transfection.24.When cells are passaged at least twice, seed for transfection.a.To the 10 cm plate that is around 80% confluent, remove all the media, and add 5 mL of TrypLE.b.Incubate at 37°C for 5 min.c.Add 5 mL of cell culture media, wash the plate and collect into a 50 mL conical.d.Spin the cells at 700 g for 5 min at 4°C.e.Remove the media and resuspend the cell pellet in 5 mL of warmed media.f.To a separate Eppendorf tube, add 80 uL of Trypan blue with 20 uL of the cell mixture.g.Add 10 uL of the hemacytometer to count the cells.h.Following cell counts, dilute the cells to 150,000 cells/mL in fresh media.i.Add 2 mL of the diluted media to the desired wells that are to be transfected.j.Incubate in the 37°C incubator for 12–16 h.25.To prepare for transfection, allow TransIT-X2 and OptiMEM to equilibrate to room temperature before use.a.Prepare the transfection mixture exactly from top to bottom and mix well between addition of reagents making sure that none of it gets onto the sides.CRITICAL: Add the TransIT-X2 last. This transfection reagent forms complexes as soon as it is added to the OptiMEM. If not added last, transfection complexes will be formed without your minicircle.b.Make one transfection mix for mcTBX4 and mcEmpty. (Table 5).Note: X refers to the amount of volume required to aliquot 2500 ng of DNA. This will be subtracted to get the amount of OptiMEM needed to bring the reaction up to 257.5 uL.Table 5Transfection mix per one well of a 6-well plateReagentFinal concentration or amountAmountMinicircle DNA2500 ngx uLOptiMEMN/A250 – x uLTransIT-X2N/A7.5 uLTotalN/A257.5 uLc.Pipette up and down after the addition of TransIT-X2 and allow to incubate for 30 min in the hood.d.During the incubation step aspirate the media of the wells to be transfected and add 2.5 mL of warmed media.e.After incubation, add the minicircle transfection mixture dropwise.f.Gently rock the plate in vertically and horizontally to evenly distribute the mixture and put cells back into the incubator to incubate for 12–16 h.g.The following day, remove the media and add 3 mL of warmed media.26.After 72 h post-transfection, prepare for RNA extraction.a.Aspirate all media from the wells.b.Add 500 uL of TryPLE and incubate at 37°C for 3 min.c.After, wash the plate with 1 mL of DMEM 10% FBS 1% Antianti.d.Collect the contents into a 1.5 mL tube and spin the cells 500 g for 5 min at 4°C.e.Leaving the cell pellet untouched, aspirate 1450 uL (725 uL twice) using a pipette.f.Add 300 uL of RNA lysis buffer from the RNA Microprep kit and follow manufacturer’s instructions for the rest of the extraction. steps.title: Thaw miniprep cultures and resuspend
steps.instruction: Remove the miniprep cultures from storage, let them thaw on ice, and resuspend each pellet in 600 µL ultrapure water using the Zyppy Miniprep Kit, following the manufacturer’s instructions; incubate the elution buffer at 55 °C–60 °C before elution and measure DNA concentration with a Nanodrop.

steps.title: Set up restriction digest
steps.instruction: For each sample, combine enough DNA to give 250 ng with ultrapure water to a final volume of 20 µL, add 2 µL 10× Cutsmart Buffer, 1 µL EcoRI‑HF (20 units), mix, and incubate at 37 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Prepare 1% agarose gel
steps.instruction: Weigh 1 g agarose into a 500 mL Pyrex bottle, add 100 mL 1× TAE, microwave 30 s with 15 s pauses to dissolve, run under cool water 30 s, add 5 µL SYBR Green stain, and allow the gel to solidify for 45 min at bench temperature.

steps.title: Load samples and run electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL 6× loading dye to each digest, load 5 µL 1 kb ladder in the first lane, load the samples, run the gel at 100 V for 30 min, then visualize with a gel‑doc.

steps.title: Evaluate gel for parental plasmid
steps.instruction: If parental plasmid contamination is <10 % and no genomic DNA is visible, the preparation is acceptable and you may proceed to maxiprep; otherwise repeat miniprep or troubleshoot.

steps.title: Calculate maxiprep scaling factor
steps.instruction: For an OD₆₀₀ of 6 in a 200 mL post‑induction culture, compute Maximum Culture Volume = 750 / OD₆₀₀ = 125 mL; scaling factor = 200 mL / 125 mL = 1.6. Multiply all kit reagent volumes by 1.6 as listed in Table 3.

steps.title: Perform scaled maxiprep with endotoxin removal
steps.instruction: Using the GeneJet Endo‑free Plasmid Maxiprep Kit (K0861), apply the scaled reagent volumes (Resuspension 11.2 mL, Lysis 11.2 mL, Neutralization 11.2 mL, Endotoxin Binding 1.6 mL, Isopropanol 6.4 mL). For each 20 mL flow‑through, add 8 mL isopropanol, use one white column per flask, combine flow‑throughs onto a single blue column, and elute with buffer pre‑incubated at 55 °C–60 °C.

steps.title: Validate maxiprep DNA quality
steps.instruction: Repeat the restriction digest and gel electrophoresis as in steps 2‑4; confirm 260/280 ratio of 1.8–2.0 and 260/230 ratio of 2.0–2.7; store acceptable DNA at –20 °C indefinitely.

steps.title: Prepare HEK293T cells for transfection
steps.instruction: Thaw HEK293T cells (grip 2 min), resuspend in 10 mL DMEM + 10 % FBS + 1 % Antibiotic (warmed 37 °C), pellet at 300 g / 5 min / 4 °C, repeat wash, plate 10 cm dish, grow to 80‑90 % confluence, then split twice using 5 mL TrypLE (37 °C 5 min), wash with 5 mL media, collect, pellet at 700 g 5 min, resuspend in 5 mL warm media, seed new 10 cm plates with 9 mL media + 1 mL cell suspension, repeat to ensure healthy growth.

steps.title: Seed HEK293T cells for transfection
steps.instruction: After at least two passages, detach cells with 5 mL TrypLE (37 °C 5 min), collect, pellet 700 g 5 min / 4 °C, resuspend in 5 mL warm media, count using Trypan Blue (80 µL dye + 20 µL cells, 10 µL hemacytometer), dilute to 150 000 cells/mL, add 2 mL diluted media to each well of a 6‑well plate, incubate 12–16 h at 37 °C / 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Prepare TransIT‑X2 transfection mix
steps.instruction: For each well, calculate the volume of OptiMEM needed to bring the reaction to 250 µL after adding 2500 ng minicircle DNA (X µL), then add 7.5 µL TransIT‑X2; total volume = 257.5 µL. Mix thoroughly, incubate 30 min at room temperature, then add 2.5 mL warmed media to the well, add the transfection mixture dropwise, rock plate vertically and horizontally, and incubate 12–16 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Post‑transfection handling and imaging
steps.instruction: The following day replace media with 3 mL warmed media; image cells with a fluorescence microscope 48 h post‑transfection to visualize mCherry‑P2A‑TBX4 expression.

steps.title: Prepare NIH/3T3 cells for transcription assay
steps.instruction: Thaw NIH/3T3 cells (grip 2 min), resuspend in 10 mL DMEM + 10 % FBS + 1 % Antibiotic (37 °C), pellet 300 g 5 min 4 °C, repeat wash, plate 10 cm dish, grow to 80‑90 % confluence, split twice using 5 mL TrypLE (37 °C 5 min), wash, collect, pellet 700 g 5 min, resuspend in 5 mL warm media, count with Trypan Blue, dilute to 150 000 cells/mL, add 2 mL diluted media per well of a 6‑well plate, incubate 12–16 h.

steps.title: Transfect NIH/3T3 cells with minicircle
steps.instruction: Prepare the same TransIT‑X2 mix as in step 9, add to each well after aspirating media and adding 2.5 mL warmed media, rock plate, incubate 12–16 h at 37 °C; the next day replace media with 3 mL warmed media.

steps.title: Extract RNA 72 h post‑transfection
steps.instruction: Aspirate all media, add 500 µL TrypLE, incubate 37 °C 3 min, wash with 1 mL DMEM + 10 % FBS + 1 % Antibiotic, collect cells into a 1.5 mL tube, spin 500 g 5 min 4 °C, aspirate 1450 µL supernatant (two × 725 µL), add 300 µL RNA lysis buffer (RNA Microprep kit), follow kit instructions, elute in 15 µL ultrapure water, keep on ice.

steps.title: Quantify RNA and assess purity
steps.instruction: Measure RNA concentration with a Nanodrop; ensure A260/280 ratio is >2.0 before proceeding.

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA from RNA
steps.instruction: Adjust RNA to 500 ng in a final volume of 10 µL with RNase/DNase‑free water (add water if needed). On ice, assemble 2× RT master mix per reaction: 2 µL 10× RT Buffer, 0.8 µL 25× dNTP Mix, 2 µL 10× RT Random Primers, 4.2 µL RNase/DNase‑free water, 1 µL MultiScribe Reverse Transcriptase (multiply volumes by number of reactions). Aliquot 10 µL master mix into an 8‑strip PCR tube, add 10 µL RNA mixture, and run thermocycler: 25 °C 10 min, 37 °C 120 min, 85 °C 5 min, hold indefinitely at 4 °C.

steps.title: Set up TaqMan qPCR
steps.instruction: Dilute cDNA 1:10 by mixing 3 µL undiluted cDNA with 27 µL nuclease‑free water. For each probe, prepare a 10 µL reaction: 5 µL 2× TaqMan Fast Advanced Master Mix, 0.5 µL 20× TaqMan probe, 2.5 µL water (total 8 µL). Pipette 2 µL diluted cDNA into each well of a 96‑well plate, add 8 µL master mix, tap plate three times, seal with optical adhesive, run on QuantStudio 3 using Comparative Ct (no melt curve), and analyze data with the ΔΔCt method.

description: The protocol describes a minicircle harvesting protocol from parental plasmids containing attB, attP, and 32 copies of Isce-I endonuclease sites in the minicircle producing bacteria, ZYCY10PS3T2.
